title: The Last Weather Report
premise: A retired weather observer helps her neighbors care for their community garden.

chapters.title: The Cold Comes Early
beats: Ada is packing the old weather station when Luis asks for help protecting the garden from a possible frost.
Despite her reluctance, Ada joins Luis and they cover the vulnerable plants with sheets.

chapters.title: Morning
beats: Ada returns to the garden before Luis arrives and checks the covered plants.
Luis thanks Ada and invites her to help the volunteers keep a record of local weather observations.
Ada considers the offer and agrees to come back the following week.
